clue.text: Poet lying in the sun?

definitions.meaning: sunbathing so that the skin gets a tan

explanation.definitionFit: The poet is Robert or Elizabeth Barrett Browning; someone sunbathing is getting a tan, hence the playful question mark.

clue.text: Well-stocked salesman allowed to open emporium

parts.note: a rep is a travelling sales representative
let means allowed or permitted

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, here from emporium

explanation.surface: A salesman is permitted to open a well-stocked store.
explanation.definitionFit: Replete means filled to capacity, fully supplied with something.

clue.text: He helps the master at assembly

definitions.text: He helps the master at assembly

parts.words: He helps the master at assembly
parts.note: reads like a pupil aiding a schoolmaster at morning assembly, but it is the huntsman's assistant who keeps hounds together for the Master of Foxhounds

explanation.definitionFit: In foxhunting this assistant to the huntsman controls the pack, keeping the hounds gathered for the Master.

clue.text: Receptacle that needs emptying daily

parts.note: sounds like a bin or chamber pot but describes the office tray for incoming papers, to be cleared each day

explanation.definitionFit: An office tray holding incoming correspondence and documents awaiting attention, ideally cleared each working day.

clue.text: Last in the ring, we hear

definitions.text: Last in the ring, we hear

parts.words: Last in the ring, we hear
parts.note: suggests a boxer or circus act, but means the final opera of Wagner's Ring cycle, heard in performance

explanation.definitionFit: Twilight of the Gods is the fourth and closing music drama of Wagner's Der Ring des Nibelungen.

clue.text: Full significance of odd man out

indicators.note: odd suggests something strange or out of place, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The real meaning of being the odd one out of a group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odd' looks like part of the phrase 'odd man out', but it is the anagram signal working on MAN OUT.
explanation.definitionFit: The amount of a statement is its total import or sum, as in 'that amounts to a refusal'.

clue.text: Bloodstock?

parts.note: normally means thoroughbred horses, but read as the stock of one's bloodline, a family lineage

explanation.definitionFit: Lineage or descent is the line of blood from which a person comes.

clue.text: Open a French cul-de-sac

parts.note: un is the French for a
a close is a residential dead-end street in Britain

explanation.surface: A Parisian dead-end street that is open at one end.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a 'close' is a short residential street closed at one end.
explanation.definitionFit: To unclose is an archaic or poetic verb meaning to open up.

clue.text: Recording radio readings?

parts.note: sounds like taping broadcasts, but means instruments measuring at a distance and transmitting their figures by radio

explanation.definitionFit: This technology gathers measurements remotely and sends the data by radio signal to a receiving station.

clue.text: Run second impression

parts.note: a print is an impression made from a plate or block

explanation.surface: A newspaper runs a second impression of an edition.
explanation.definitionFit: To sprint is to run at full speed over a short distance.

clue.text: Cunning needed to prune tall cacti variety

indicators.note: a variety is a different form, so the remaining letters are rearranged
pruning cuts something back, so one letter is trimmed from the word tall

explanation.surface: A gardener needs cunning to cut back a tall kind of cactus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to prune' drops one L from TALL, leaving TAL; 'variety' then rearranges TAL with CACTI.
explanation.definitionFit: Tactical means shrewdly planned for an advantage, so cunning in the adjectival sense.

clue.text: Jumbo perhaps has a black face

parts.note: jet is a deep glossy black
a plane is a flat surface or face, as of a crystal

explanation.surface: An elephant named Jumbo might have a dark face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jumbo' suggests an elephant, but a jumbo is a large airliner, given as an example by 'perhaps'.
explanation.definitionFit: A jumbo jet is one example of a jet-powered aircraft, hence 'perhaps'.

clue.text: Hot wind, low mistral initially, is backing

indicators.note: backing means the whole string of pieces is read in reverse order

parts.note: to low is to moo like cattle

indicators.note: initially picks out the opening letter of the word mistral

explanation.surface: A hot wind, with a gentle mistral, is starting to blow back across the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is backing' reverses MOO + M + IS, the whole string read right to left.
explanation.definitionFit: The simoom is a hot, dry, dust-laden desert wind of Arabia and North Africa.

clue.text: Imperial poet with a grasp of English

indicators.note: grasping something means holding it inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a bard is a poet

explanation.surface: A poet of the Empire who has a good command of the English language.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Imperial' looks like an adjective, but it is the noun: a small pointed tuft of beard below the lower lip, named after Napoleon III.
explanation.definitionFit: An imperial is a style of facial hair, a small pointed tuft below the lip.

clue.text: Not sustained, naturally?

parts.note: a baby not nourished at the breast, the natural way, but from a teat and flask

explanation.definitionFit: A baby given formula from a feeding vessel rather than breastfed is fed this way.

clue.text: Mordent an unusual decoration?

indicators.note: unusual means out of the ordinary order, signalling the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A musician wonders whether a trill-like ornament counts as an odd embellishment.
explanation.walkthrough: A mordent is itself a musical ornament, so the surface is almost a definition in its own right.
explanation.definitionFit: An adornment is something added to beautify, a synonym of ornament or trimming.

clue.text: Home at ten, dishevelled and decrepit

indicators.note: dishevelled means untidy and disordered, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone comes home at ten looking scruffy and worn out.
explanation.definitionFit: Moth-eaten means shabby and worn out, as cloth chewed by moths is, hence decrepit.

clue.text: Task on the house not subject to tax

parts.note: a duty is a task one must do
something on the house is given free of charge

explanation.surface: A job that the pub offers on the house is exempt from tax.
explanation.definitionFit: Duty-free goods are exempt from customs or excise charges.

clue.text: What's-his-name is slight and clinging

parts.note: slight means thin or slender
something gummy is sticky and clings

explanation.surface: A forgotten acquaintance remembered only as skinny and needy.
explanation.definitionFit: Thingummy is a placeholder word used for a person or thing whose name one cannot recall.

clue.text: Fiery sort of rock

definitions.meaning: of or like fire, from Latin ignis
a type of rock formed from cooled magma

explanation.definitionFit: Igneous means relating to fire, and igneous rock is formed from solidified molten magma.

clue.text: State Shelley's Paradise of exiles

definitions.meaning: Shelley's poem Julian and Maddalo calls this country the paradise of exiles

explanation.definitionFit: Italy is a European nation, and Shelley, himself living abroad there, named it the paradise of exiles in Julian and Maddalo.

clue.text: Forward, against the head, stops another on the bolt

parts.note: in rugby a lock is a second-row forward
nut is slang for the head

explanation.surface: A rugby forward playing against the head of the scrum stops an opponent breaking.
explanation.walkthrough: In rugby, 'against the head' means winning the ball on the opponent's put-in, but here 'against' only joins the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A locknut is an extra nut screwed down over the first to prevent it working loose on a bolt.

clue.text: Girl's array to win people over?

parts.note: Di's: Di is a short girl's name, with the possessive giving the S
to array is to equip or furnish, as to arm troops

explanation.surface: A girl's display of charm might win people over.
explanation.definitionFit: To disarm critics is to charm them out of hostility, making them friendly.

clue.text: For dementia, girl is given injection of sodium

indicators.note: an injection puts something inside, so one piece goes within the girl's name

parts.note: Lucy is a girl's name
Na is the chemical symbol for sodium

explanation.surface: A girl suffering from dementia receives an injection of sodium as treatment.
explanation.definitionFit: Lunacy is an old word for madness or mental derangement, loosely equal to dementia.

clue.text: "The Knoll", address suitable for a cardinal?

definitions.meaning: a knoll is a small hill or rise of ground
the formal style used when speaking to a Roman Catholic cardinal, 'Your ...', a title of high rank

explanation.definitionFit: An eminence is a piece of rising ground, and His Eminence is the title of a Roman Catholic cardinal.

clue.text: Is this noise reduced greatly in a mini?

definitions.text: Is this noise reduced greatly in a mini?

parts.words: Is this noise reduced greatly in a mini?
parts.note: the swishing rustle of a long full skirt would hardly be heard from a very short miniskirt with little fabric

explanation.definitionFit: Frou-frou is the rustling sound of silk skirts as a woman moves, which a miniskirt would scarcely make.

clue.text: Temporary theatre

definitions.meaning: performance on stage as an art or profession

explanation.definitionFit: An acting head holds the post for the time being; acting is also the craft of stage performance.

clue.text: Fancy the public transport from Tennessee?

definitions.meaning: to fancy is to want or long for
Tennessee Williams wrote the play A Streetcar Named ...

explanation.definitionFit: Desire is longing; Tennessee Williams's play names a New Orleans streetcar with this word.

clue.text: Arranged in pairs, shoot right away

indicators.note: away means the letter for right is taken out of the longer word

parts.note: to germinate is to sprout or shoot

explanation.surface: Seeds planted in pairs sprout right away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right away' reads as 'immediately', but it tells you to remove R.
explanation.definitionFit: Geminate, from the Latin for twin, describes things occurring in pairs, as leaves or consonants.
